name: open-science
description: The open-source AI research workbench for scientific research and agent workflows. Local-first, model-agnostic desktop app with extensible skills, MCP tools and connectors, Python/R execution and traceable artifacts for reproducible research on macOS, Windows and Linux.

analysis.summary_en: AIPOCH Open-Science is a local-first open-source AI research workbench for reproducible science, with flexible model backends.
highlights: Built-in Agent upgrades: Use Codex subscriptions for the main agent and subagents, select Claude Fable 5.2 with a 1M context window, and use provider-supported output limits.
